data.label: Unreal Engine 5
data.description: 虚幻引擎 5 是一款由 Epic Games 开发的次世代游戏引擎，于 2022 年正式发布。作为虚幻引擎系列的最新迭代，它旨在实现影视级的实时渲染精度。该引擎最初虽以开发高质量射击游戏闻名，但凭借其强大的 Nanite（虚拟化微多边形几何体）和 Lumen（动态全局光照）技术，现已广泛应用于超大规模开放世界游戏、影视虚拟制作、建筑可视化及汽车模拟等多个前沿领域。

data.label: Unreal Engine 5
data.description: Unreal Engine 5 is a next-generation game engine developed by Epic Games, officially released in 2022. As the latest iteration of the Unreal Engine series, it aims to achieve cinematic-quality real-time rendering precision. While the engine was originally renowned for developing high-quality shooters, it is now widely utilized in massive open-world games, film and television virtual production, architectural visualization, and automotive simulation, powered by its Nanite (Virtualized Micropolygon Geometry) and Lumen (Dynamic Global Illumination) technologies.
